text:
maya.p: Heads-up — I'm pushing the RBAC role rename to staging now. We're renaming `inference_admin` -> `model_serving_admin`. This is a refactor to consolidate serving permissions; SDKs that hardcode role strings may break. CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/1234 :eyes:

sam.k: What's the migration plan? Do we have an alias mapping so existing bindings don't immediately break prod?

jordan_r: PR #342 adds an alias map in the authz service. We'll keep automatic aliasing for 7 days, then log and remove old-name resolution. I've opened a docs PR (https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/78) with steps.

maya.p: Good. Also: note for Dedicated customers we need to include a note about tenant-scoped bindings.

jordan_r: Quick SDK note for Python (we'll push a patch):
```python
# simple aliasing shim (temporary)
client.role_aliases = {"inference_admin": "model_serving_admin"}
# existing checks still work
client.check(client.role_aliases.get("inference_admin"), resource)
```
This prevents churn for callers that pass the old string. We'll add equivalent for node/go.

audit-bot: audit log entry created: id=log_2026_03_19_01 user=maya.p action=role.rename details="inference_admin -> model_serving_admin"

lee: QA found a permissions gap in staging: our deploy runner svc-account still only has `deploy.write` bound, but the new role doesn't include `kms.decrypt` which is required for model artifact decrypt during deploy. Result: deploys fail with `403 KMS:Decrypt`.

carla: That's expected — KMS access was explicit before via `inference_admin` binding. Two options: 1) add `kms:Decrypt` into `model_serving_admin` policy, or 2) bind `kms-decrypt` granular role to `svc-deploy-runner`. We should prefer option 2 for least privilege.

sam.k: If we go with option 2 we need a CLI command to run in staging and a docs note. Proposed command:
```
rbacctl bind --role kms-decrypt --principal svc-deploy-runner --env staging
```

lee: Temporary workaround applied in staging (rbacctl bind as above) — redeploy succeeds. Filing follow-up ticket TKT-529 to ensure infra automation picks this up.

carla: Also note for Private installs: KMS key policy needs to explicitly allow the new role/principal. Docs update: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/79

jordan_r: For the SDK release notes: include backward-compatibility snippet and sample migration steps: search-and-replace role strings, or add alias shim. We'll bump minor semver and tag as "rbac-migration-2026-03".

maya.p: I'll merge the docs + python/node SDK patches today after QA signoff. Will coordinate a short maintenance window (11pm PT) for the tenant mappings to flip. @sam.k can you confirm the rollout window?

sam.k: Confirmed 11pm PT. I'll post in #eng and #customer-notify. Also recommend we run a canary of 10% customers first.

carla: Extra reminder — update audit-queries in observability (index: `audit-*`) to look for either role name for 14 days. Example ES query: `role:("inference_admin" OR "model_serving_admin")`

maya.p: Thanks team. After rollout we'll run the post-mortem checklist, update the RBAC FAQ with the new role mapping, and keep aliases active for 7 days.

lee: Logged the incident in postmortems: PMTR-201.

sam.k: Nice work. :tada:
